query: How do blended-finance instruments (first-loss, concessional tranches, revenue-based instruments) affect private co-investor participation and follow-on capital rates?

response.query: How do blended-finance instruments (first-loss, concessional tranches, revenue-based instruments) affect private co-investor participation and follow-on capital rates?
response.answer: Blended-finance instruments reduce private investors' risk, encouraging higher participation and follow-on capital rates. First-loss positions protect investors, while concessional tranches attract more private capital. This catalytic capital lowers risk perception for private funders.
